display: Saubhari, the sage of the Kalindi

depiction_rules.notes: D054-only named sage, shown in the water or on its bank as required by the stanza. Use ordinary human anatomy and a calm ascetic presence.

visual_bible.face: Quiet, contemplative face with natural features
visual_bible.skin: Muted warm-brown mineral pigment, clearly brown rather than orange
visual_bible.hair: Dark hair gathered simply, with a natural beard
visual_bible.build: Ordinary slender human proportions, two attached arms and legs
visual_bible.clothing: Simple cream or muted saffron ascetic wrap, modestly arranged for underwater meditation
visual_bible.continuity_markers: The same solitary ascetic identity in stanzas 1 and 2; seated meditation posture in water where shown

never: no underwater bubbles obscuring the face
no magical powers or unsupported props
no extra, missing, fused, or detached limbs
no readable text, watermark, gloss, or cinematic light beams
